## What this dashboard shows

- The dashboard demonstrates the technical architecture connecting SAP data to Snowflake for unified governance and AI-powered analysis across the group.
- Currently live: 65 things and 130 links in one spine, 5 ontology tables in the semantic view.
- The agent passed 20/21 test questions in its last evaluation.

## What to report

- SAP data products are shared into Snowflake via SAP BDC Zerocopy Connector with nothing extracted and nothing installed on S/4HANA, creating a single connected model across all ERPs.
- The ontology is built on catalog-linked databases feeding entity, account and journal layers, with SAP business definitions (CSN) reused for semantics and governance tags including automated masking of CSN-tagged personal data.
- Cortex Analyst and Cortex Agents answer use-case questions in plain English from the same ontology, with SQL transparency behind each answer, running under the same role model and policies as dashboards.
- Data quality and spine integrity are monitored live with checks ensuring every link points to an existing node and every ID is unique, while dynamic tables keep the group journal and account map current as ledgers land.

## Watch out for

- Openflow connectors for Oracle EBS and Dynamics 365 are marked as "Pattern" and simulated in their real source shapes in the demo rather than live production data.
- Secure data sharing from deal data rooms, Cortex AI functions for ledger classification, and lineage/access history tracing are documented as "Pattern" not yet fully live.
- Agent evaluation shows 20/21 questions passed—identify which question failed and why to understand current AI limitations.
- Confirm coverage of the "65 things and 130 links" includes all material entities and relationships for board-level confidence in completeness.
